scripts.build: npm --workspace client run build && npm --workspace server run build
scripts.dev:client: op run --env-file=client/.env -- npm --workspace client run dev
scripts.dev:server: op run --env-file=server/.env -- npm --workspace server run dev
scripts.dev:server:test-auth: op run --env-file=server/.env -- npm --workspace server run dev:test-auth
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:shared
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run test:shared
scripts.quality:large-files: find client/src server/src shared -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" \) -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/dist/*" -exec wc -l {} + | sort -nr | head -40
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run quality:deps && npm run quality:large-files
scripts.quality:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run quality:large-files
